name: conversation-lifeboat
description: Maintain durable project specifications, detect overloaded Codex conversations, and hand work off safely when requested.

interface.shortDescription: Keep project specs current and move overloaded tasks safely.
interface.longDescription: Maintains active project specifications and their prohibited, implemented, and superseded states without leaving the current task, while also monitoring transcript pressure and providing a confirmation-gated handoff into a fresh task.
defaultPrompt: Assess this task and prepare a safe handoff if it is overloaded.
Preserve this conversation in a spec and continue in a fresh task.
Update the current project specification without creating a new task.
